# MEEHAAN Enterprise

> Pune-based supplier of industrial lubricants, automotive connectors, battery
> accessories, and digital/AI services for Indian manufacturers, OEMs, and
> businesses scaling in modern India. Founded 2018. English / Hindi / Marathi.

## Industrial

- /solutions/industrial: Industrial-division overview — LUBO oils, connectors, battery accessories.
- /solutions/industrial/oils: LUBO-brand industrial lubricants (full range).
- /solutions/industrial/oils/heat-treatment: LUBOQUENCH heat-treatment and quenching oils.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/fire-resistant: Fire-resistant hydraulic fluids for equipment near heat sources.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/cutting-coolants: Metalworking cutting coolants.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/metal-forming: Metal forming oils and drawing lubricants.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/industrial-cleaners: Industrial cleaners and degreasers.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/rust-preventives: Rust preventives for short- and long-term storage.
- /solutions/industrial/oils/die-casting: Die-casting lubricants and release agents.
- /solutions/industrial/connectors: Automotive and industrial connectors (Yazaki, TE Connectivity, Molex, and others).
- /solutions/industrial/battery: Battery accessories marketplace.
- /solutions/industrial/battery/pg-glands: PG-series polyamide cable glands (PG7–PG48).
- /solutions/industrial/battery/anderson-connectors: Anderson-style high-current DC battery connectors.
- /solutions/industrial/battery/epoxy-sheets: FR-4 / G-10 epoxy insulation sheets.
- /solutions/industrial/battery/terminal-blocks: DIN-rail and PCB terminal blocks.
- /solutions/industrial/battery/degson-connectors: Degson pluggable terminals and PCB connectors.

## Digital

- /solutions/digital: Digital-division overview — custom software and AI automation.
- /solutions/digital/software: Custom industrial software development.
- /solutions/digital/ai: AI automation services (CRM, WhatsApp, workflow, finance).
- /solutions/digital/caflow: CaFlow — WhatsApp compliance automation for CA firms (GST, ITR, TDS).
